board.board_parser_note: Normalizes whitespace and recognises both 사외이사 and 독립이사 as outside directors; excludes explicitly 미등기 executives from the denominator.

caveats: Scores are screening heuristics, not legal conclusions.
Controller percentage is an estimate from structured DART data and may omit friendly blocks or duplicate total rows.
No AGM turnout, proxy voting history, valuation, NPS voting, articles-of-incorporation analysis or case-law analysis is included yet.
High-scoring companies require manual verification of the underlying filing tables.

agm_summary.interpretation: Contestability score uses only meetings with vote percentages. Legacy shareholder proposals are counted as history but do not add quantitative score points without voting percentages.
